# Load data

```{r}
# Load data
df <- readRDS("./data/dataset/df.RDS")
pclustering <- readRDS("./data/asr_clustering/blbli_asr_clustering_df.RDS")

# Tree
tr <- read.tree("./data/tree/tree.treefile")

# Gwas hits
gwas_table <- readRDS("./data/GWAS/hits/gwas_hits_table.RDS")   %>% subset(nn_qc == "Pass")
gwas_hits <- readRDS("./data/GWAS/hits/gwas_mat.RDS")

# Nearest neighbor data
nn <- readRDS("./data/nearest_neighbor_comparisons/nn_comparisons.RDS")

# Merge the data
df <- left_join(df,gwas_hits %>% mutate(isolate_no = rownames(.))) %>% left_join(.,pclustering)
```

# Figure 3A - Table

```{r ,fig.height=5.13,fig.width=7.05}
# Curate table
figure_3.A_tb <- gwas_table %>% select(locus_tag,feature_count,gene,product,resistance_category,sig_tests,sig_models_simple,sig_phenotypes,explanatory_qc)

# Update locus tag and gene and product for informative data
figure_3.A_tb$locus_tag <- recode_genotypes(figure_3.A_tb$locus_tag) 
figure_3.A_tb$gene <- ifelse(grepl(pattern = 'ompK36|OmpK36',figure_3.A_tb$locus_tag) | figure_3.A_tb$locus_tag =='KPNIH1_RS18665',"ompK36",figure_3.A_tb$gene) %>% {ifelse(is.na(.),"",.)}
figure_3.A_tb$product <- ifelse(grepl("KPNIH1_RS18100", figure_3.A_tb$locus_tag),
                                "MdtA/MuxA family multidrug efflux RND transporter periplasmic adaptor subunit",
                                figure_3.A_tb$product)
figure_3.A_tb$product <- ifelse(figure_3.A_tb$gene=='ompK36','porin OmpC',figure_3.A_tb$product)
figure_3.A_tb$product <- ifelse(grepl(pattern = 'KPC',figure_3.A_tb$locus_tag),"blaKPC-associated plasmid cluster",figure_3.A_tb$product)
figure_3.A_tb$locus_tag <- gsub("blaKPC-","<i>bla</i><sub>KPC</sub>-",figure_3.A_tb$locus_tag)
figure_3.A_tb$locus_tag <- gsub("ompK36","<i>ompK36</i>",figure_3.A_tb$locus_tag) 
figure_3.A_tb$gene <- gsub("ompK36","<i>ompK36</i>",figure_3.A_tb$gene) 
figure_3.A_tb$product <- gsub("blaKPC","<i>bla</i><sub>KPC</sub>",figure_3.A_tb$product) 
figure_3.A_tb$locus_tag <-  gsub("associated","containing",figure_3.A_tb$locus_tag)
figure_3.A_tb$product <-  gsub("associated","containing",figure_3.A_tb$product)
figure_3.A_tb$sig_models_simple <- gsub("KPC-","<i>bla</i><sub>KPC</sub>-",figure_3.A_tb$sig_models_simple) %>% gsub("associated","containing",.)
figure_3.A_tb$sig_models_simple <- gsub("High-risk variants","PFAV",figure_3.A_tb$sig_models_simple)

# Recode PFAV at first mention
idx <- which(grepl("PFAV", figure_3.A_tb$sig_models_simple))[1]
figure_3.A_tb$sig_models_simple[idx] <- gsub(
  "PFAV",
  "Putative function-altering variants (PFAVs)",
  figure_3.A_tb$sig_models_simple[idx])

# Select relevant columns
figure_3.A_tbl <- figure_3.A_tb %>%
  select(locus_tag, feature_count, gene, product, sig_tests, sig_models_simple, sig_phenotypes, explanatory_qc) %>%
  `colnames<-`(c('Significant hit', 'n', 'Gene', 'Product', 'Significant test(s)',
                 'Significant model(s)', 'Phenotype(s)', 'Explanatory genotype'))

# Select relevant columns
tbl_html <- figure_3.A_tbl %>%
  kable(format = "html", row.names = FALSE, escape = FALSE,
        align = c("l", "r", "l", "l", "l", "l", "l", "l")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("condensed", "responsive"),
                full_width = TRUE, fixed_thead = TRUE,
                font_size = 47, html_font = "Arial") %>%
  column_spec(1:ncol(figure_3.A_tbl),                                   # all columns, header included
              extra_css = "padding-left: 0.3em; padding-right: 0.3em;",
              include_thead = TRUE) %>%
  column_spec(1, extra_css = "white-space: nowrap;") %>%                # Significant hit: no wrapping
  column_spec(4, width = "22%") %>%                                     # Product   
  column_spec(5, extra_css = "white-space: nowrap;") %>%   # Significant test(s): "PhyC & Synchronous"
  column_spec(7, extra_css = "white-space: nowrap;") %>%   # Phenotype(s): "BL/BLI & IR & MVB"
  column_spec(8, extra_css = "white-space: nowrap;", include_thead = TRUE) %>%   # Explanatory genotype
  row_spec(0, background = "lightgray", color = "black", bold = TRUE) %>%
  row_spec(1:nrow(figure_3.A_tbl), background = "white",
         extra_css = "border-top: 3px solid #bdbdbd;")

save_kable(x = tbl_html, file = "tab_kbl.html")

webshot2::webshot(url = "tab_kbl.html", file = "tab_kbl.png",
                  vwidth = 4100, vheight = 700, selector = "table")
```

# Legend
```{r}
# Legend from a real variable, using the same scale as the panel
data_legend <- function(data, var, scale, glyph = "rect", key_border = TRUE) {
  data <- as.data.frame(data)
  data <- data[!is.na(data[[var]]), , drop = FALSE]
  data[[var]] <- factor(data[[var]])
  outline <- if (glyph == "boxplot") "black" else NA        # outline only the boxplot symbol
  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = .data[[var]], fill = .data[[var]])) +
    geom_bar(key_glyph = glyph, colour = outline, linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale + consistent_theme_GWAS
  if (!key_border) p <- p + theme(legend.key = element_rect(colour = NA, fill = NA))
  cowplot::get_legend(p)
}

leg_clade      <- data_legend(df, "clade_I", clade_colors_scale_v)
leg_phylo      <- data_legend(df, "blbli_asr_cluster_renamed", cluster_scale_3_col_key)
leg_resistance <- data_legend(df, "blbli_dich", resistance_scale_key)
leg_mic        <- data_legend(df, "MVB_log_2", Log2_scale_gwas_figure)
leg_genotype   <- data_legend(figure_3.df_mat, colnames(figure_3.df_mat)[1], genotype_scale_v)
leg_antibiotic <- data_legend(nn_data_melt, "variable", MVB_IR_scale,
                              glyph = "boxplot", key_border = FALSE)

legs <- list(leg_clade, leg_phylo, leg_resistance, leg_mic, leg_genotype, leg_antibiotic)

# Measure each legend's width and height (in inches)
w <- sapply(legs, function(g) grid::convertWidth(sum(g$widths),  "in", valueOnly = TRUE))
h <- sapply(legs, function(g) grid::convertHeight(sum(g$heights), "in", valueOnly = TRUE))

# Pad the bottom of each legend to match the tallest, so all titles line up
legs <- mapply(function(g, hi) gtable::gtable_add_rows(g, unit(max(h) - hi, "in"), pos = -1),
               legs, h, SIMPLIFY = FALSE)

# Spacing: equal gaps between legends, equal padding on both sides (7.05 = figure width)
gap <- 0.12
pad <- max((7.05 - sum(w) - gap * (length(legs) - 1)) / 2, 0)
rel <- c(pad, as.vector(rbind(w, gap))[-2 * length(w)], pad)

# Interleave legends with NULL spacers: NULL, leg1, NULL, leg2, ..., leg6, NULL
cells <- c(list(NULL),
           unlist(lapply(seq_along(legs), function(i)
             if (i < length(legs)) list(legs[[i]], NULL) else list(legs[[i]])),
             recursive = FALSE),
           list(NULL))

figure_3.legends <- do.call(plot_grid, c(cells, list(nrow = 1, rel_widths = rel)))
```

```{r ,fig.height=6,fig.width=7.05}
# ===== Panel A: table =====
info  <- magick::image_info(magick::image_read("tab_kbl.png"))
tbl_h <- 7.05 * info$height / info$width             # height (in) needed at full width

fig_h <- 6                                      # total figure height (in); max 10.24
tbl_w <- 6.65                                   # table width (in), leaving ~0.15 in each side
tbl_h <- tbl_w * info$height / info$width       # height needed at that width
a     <- 1.155 * tbl_h / (fig_h - tbl_h)

figure_3.A <- ggdraw() + cowplot::draw_image("tab_kbl.png")
unlink(c("tab_kbl.html", "tab_kbl.png"))

figure_3.FA <- plot_grid(figure_3.A, labels = "A", label_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.margin = unit(c(0.05, 0, 0, 0), "cm"))

# ===== Panel B: tree, no legends =====
figure_3.FB <- plot_grid(figure_3.phylo + theme(legend.position = "none"),
                         labels = "B", label_size = 12)

# ===== Panels C and D, no legends =====
figure_3.FCD <- plot_grid(
  figure_3.C + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  figure_3.D + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  nrow = 2, labels = c("C", "D"), label_size = 12, align = "hv", label_x = -0.02)

# ===== Assemble: table / panels B-D / shared legend row =====
figure_3.FCDB <- plot_grid(figure_3.FB, figure_3.FCD, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(1, 0.7))

# Figure size 
leg_share <- 0.125                                   # was 0.155
a <- (1 + leg_share) * tbl_h / (fig_h - tbl_h)

figure_3 <- plot_grid(figure_3.FA, figure_3.FCDB, figure_3.legends,
                      nrow = 3, rel_heights = c(a, 1, leg_share))
figure_3
```
